scope: All saved complete ED scans and finite result/charge-sector payloads matching documented energy schemas, including all recorded caps. No fabricated reflected variational measurements. Checkpoint iteration metadata and ad hoc energies in logs excluded. Infinite non-number-conserving expectation values remain in physics48_summary.json, not exact sector curves.
remaining_limitations: Missing saved results are not reconstructed from log text; finite variational minima cannot order unconverged sectors rigorously.
